title: KapeKubo
description: KapeKubo blends Create-based automation with challenging, cooperative adventures, enhancing vanilla gameplay with quality-of-life features and diverse decorative blocks.

![KapeKubo Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1317de2224f7a615a4ecafca4e90decf0e7b4350.png)
# KapeKubo: Build, Explore, and Chill Together!

Welcome to KapeKubo! This modpack is your perfect Minecraft "Cafe" (Kape) and "Home" (Kubo) – a place to build amazing things and have fun adventures.


## Create Mod
![Create Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b17c42c0ca3c471740edf4b3495ae1520cc7534.jpeg)

At its core, KapeKubo is all about the **Create** mod. Get ready to build awesome machines, factories, and automate everything you can imagine!


## Decorative Blocks
![New Block Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e5ec5701f3ab1f8b9a1a7bf15bd4cadc8dc422f.jpeg)

We've also added lots of quality-of-life tweaks to make Minecraft feel even better, plus tons of new decorative blocks from mods like Beautify: Refabricated, Chipped, Chisel Reborn, Decorative Blocks, Macaw’s Bridges, Macaw’s Fences, Walls, Furnitures, and Supplementaries for you to build your dream base.


## Exciting Adventure Awaits
![Adventure Awaits Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f892c26485a67d1dc55547f806826e175a6fa6bd.jpeg)

The world generation doesn't add many new biome-specific blocks (except for a few). But there's more to explore! To encourage players to explore and work together, this modpack is designed to make the world feel more perilous and rewarding, making cooperative expeditions essential. The world in this modpack is enhanced for adventure:

- Structures are **rarer**, so finding them feels special.
- The **farther** you go from spawn, the **stronger** mobs get, making exploration challenging.
- Look out for new **illagers** and their unique **structures**!
- Face dozens of new **bosses** that will truly test your skills!
- Watch out for **dragons** – they make exploring dangerous and exciting!
  
Build your perfect home, enjoy the chill vibes, and embark on thrilling journeys with KapeKubo!
